description:
What the 911 calls around an address are about: business alarms, police, fire and EMS, behavioural crisis. Returns the true matching count, up to six example rows, and a link to the dataset's documentation.

Example invocations:
- "What are the 911 calls near this corner about?"
- "How many business alarm calls on this block?"

address.description: A street address in the seven-county Minneapolis-St. Paul metro, city after a comma. Omit for the market-wide count.

cut.description: all: every call; alarms: business alarms only; police: police responded; fire: fire and EMS responded; crisis: behavioral crisis team. Default all.

within_ft.description: Radius in feet around `address`. Default 5280 (one mile), capped at 26400.

name: calls_for_service_nearby
title: 911 Calls Nearby
